medical — Tenants age 62 or older, or tenants with a disability, may end a lease if a doctor certifies they can no longer live independently and they move to a family member's home or a care facility (N.Y. Real Property Law § 227-a).
roommate_rules: Roommates who all sign one lease are jointly and severally liable, so each one can be held responsible for the full rent, not just a share. One roommate cannot evict another; only the landlord can start an eviction, and a departing co-tenant stays liable until the landlord releases them in writing.
